APIs for tracking and rotating gossip peers with stake buckets and prune bloom filters.

# Purpose
`fd_active_set.h` defines the interface and data layout for an active peer set used by the gossip layer. It stores up to 300 peers in 25 stake buckets, with 12 peers per bucket, and it keeps a bloom filter for each peer to record pruned origins. The API provides functions to create or join the shared object, select peers for message forwarding, map an internal peer index to a pubkey, record prune information, and rotate peers by sampling from CRDS data.
